task: Find the wiki page of ohmyzsh on GitHub and tell me how to change the theme of zsh to agnoster.
answer: Per the ohmyzsh wiki Themes page (https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki/Themes): to change the zsh theme to agnoster, edit ~/.zshrc and set ZSH_THEME="agnoster" (set ZSH_THEME to the name of the theme in your ~/.zshrc, before sourcing Oh My Zsh), then apply the change by running source ~/.zshrc (or reopening the terminal). The agnoster theme additionally requires installing a patched Powerline/Nerd Font to render its special characters, and you can optionally set DEFAULT_USER to your username in ~/.zshrc to hide the user@hostname info.
